messages:
anjali: Starting a quick thread about the Quickstart/onboarding refresh. Plan: single-page hello-world (JS + Python), auth setup (PKCE for browser + server-side API key example), tiny Docker local dev, and a GitHub Actions flow for first deployment. I'll draft a PR tonight.

tyler: Love it. Can we keep the hello-world under 30 lines each so it's copy-paste friendly? Also add a tiny curl token fetch for debugging.

mahmoud: For server examples let's use the new client: `from redwood_inference import Client` and show server-side token rotation note.

rene: FYI the sidebar has a broken link to /getting-started/old-quickstart.html. We should add a redirect and update nav order.

anjali: Good catch @rene. I'll add a redirect and a short migration blurb for Dedicated customers (host override + KMS note).

mahmoud: Proposed Python snippet (one-liner style):
```py
from redwood_inference import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Hello from Redwood!')
print(resp.text)
```

tyler: JS snippet for browser (PKCE flow pointer):
```js
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate('Hello from Redwood!');
console.log(out.text);
```

anjali: I'll make both snippets use package v0.10 and add a one-paragraph explanation of PKCE vs API key. Also include a small note: `REDWOOD_HOST` for Dedicated.

tyler: Add a tiny Docker Compose for local dev that serves a static index.html and demonstrates redirect URI at http://localhost:3000/auth/callback. Keep it optional.

mahmoud: Also include a minimal GitHub Actions job that builds the demo and runs `npm ci && npm run build` so CI catches missing env vars.

rene: Can we add a Troubleshooting accordion with quick fixes: 401 => check API key / scopes; CORS => add allowed origins; preview 404 => check redirect rule.

anjali: Will do. Draft PR 289 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289 branch: docs/quickstart-hello-deploy. Marked as draft.

docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #289. Build ID: preview-289.

preview-bot: Staging site: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/289 (expires in 5 days).

tyler: Quick note on wording: avoid 'signup' vs 'sign up' inconsistency. I'll run a pass to standardize.

mahmoud: I'll test the Python example with our local mock server and post any fixes.

rene: I'll handle the sidebar redirect and add the migration snippet for Dedicated customers: mention `REDWOOD_HOST`, `REDWOOD_KMS_KEY`, and rotate tokens every 30d.

anjali: Thanks all. Ping me for reviews once CI passes. ETA: tomorrow midday. :rocket:
